verdict.rationale: Brex provides detailed API reference docs (openapi/*.md pages) and a Postman workspace with collections for all APIs, which allows some hands-on exploration, but there's no evidence of an interactive in-browser API reference with embedded runnable examples (e.g., a Swagger/OpenAPI explorer); a probe for standard openapi.json/swagger endpoints returned 404s. Missing for 10: an embedded interactive console/try-it feature, confirmation of runnable code snippets directly in docs, and independent corroboration of hands-on use.
